honestLimits: No provider call, no checkout session, no webhook and no pay UI exist yet; P1a is schema + state machine only, and the production flag is off.
Creator price setting has an API but no studio UI yet (P1b), and no production guide has a price.
Refunds are recorded only for the fake provider; provider refunds are P4.
Payouts are a ledger placeholder; no money transfer logic exists.
P5 live readiness still needs the legal entity name/country, Kinnso Stripe account + KYC, payout bank, final cancellation text and Stripe test keys/webhook secret.
